bundlingNotes: NOTABLE VINTAGE CAVEAT: this is a 2000-effective-date document (re-hosted/modified in 2022 without an updated effective date), making it by far the oldest rate filing found in this survey and likely superseded in practice even though it is the only current WFG OK document indexed. Unusually among WFG's state manuals, this one DOES include genuine dollar-denominated ancillary fees (Chart B abstract fees, Chart C title examination/final report/simultaneous issue fees) directly alongside the premium chart, rather than excluding them -- a rarer, richer disclosure pattern than WFG's typical exclusion language seen in other states. Given its age, these dollar figures are flagged as likely outdated and are excluded from the state's current observed service-stack range calculation (see OK.md methodology note).
